# InfinityOS

> InfinityOS is an AI-native personal operating system project exploring local intelligence, voice interaction and distributed computing.

## Official pages

- [Meet InfinityOS](https://www.meetinfinityos.com/): Project vision, desktop screenshots, and an overview of the user experience.
- [InfinityOS whitepapers](https://www.meetinfinityos.com/whitepaper.html): Read the online overview and check the publication status of planned papers.
- [Investor overview](https://www.meetinfinityos.com/invest.html): Development priorities, potential commercial models, and risks. These are plans, not financial projections or guarantees.
